question: Radha Reddy and Raja Reddy are famous proponents of which dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Radha Reddy and Raja Reddy** are renowned exponents of **Kuchipudi dance form**, which originated in** Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• Kuchipudi is a** classical Indian dance form** that combines **storytelling, drama, and dance.**
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements, intricate footwork,** and** expressive facial expressions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is another classical Indian dance form that originated in** Tamil Nadu.**

 
 
• It is characterized by** rhythmic footwork, intricate hand gestures,** and** elaborate costumes.**
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical Indian dance form that originated in** Kerala.**
 
 
• It is known for its **fluid movements**, subtle facial expressions, and graceful hand gestures.
 
 
 
• **Kathakal**i is a classical Indian dance-drama form that originated in** Kerala.**
 
 
• It is known for its** elaborate makeup, colorful costumes,** and exaggerated facial expressions.
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct** answer to the question is option 1, Kuchipudi.
